fact: Diggermattock Hall is occupied by roughly two dozen Svirfneblin.
source_quote: Roughly two dozen Svirfneblin occupied the well-lit cavern.
subject: Diggermattock Hall population

fact: Dorbo is one of the two male and female Svirfneblin leaders seated at the stone desks in Diggermattock Hall.
source_quote: A male and female Svirfneblin sat there conferring with one another
subject: Dorbo Diggermattock

fact: Senni is Dorbo's assistant and co-leader, seated at one of the two stone desks.
source_quote: My name is Dorbo. And over here is my assistant, Senni.
subject: Senni Diggermattock
